# AUDIT-2026-06-08

Scope: normalization of invalid `model:` identifiers across the agent fleet
(`.github/agents/*.agent.md`). This file exists to satisfy meta-change
traceability (HARD RULE 24) for the commit that rewrites those frontmatter
values.

## Context

Every `.agent.md` declared a `model:` field using placeholder or non-existent
identifiers (`claude-sonnet-4.x`, `claude-sonnet-4.7`, `claude-opus-4.7`).
These strings are not valid VS Code model ids, so the agent runtime fell back
to the active model instead of the model intended by
[`model-policy.md`](../model-policy.md). The fix aligns each agent's `model:`
with a valid identifier while preserving the Opus/Sonnet split documented in
the policy.

## Changes introduced

- **F-201 — Opus agents.** Set `model: Claude Opus 4.1` for the 11 agents the
  policy assigns to Opus: `requirements-lead`, `requirements-analyst`,
  `requirements-threat-intel`, `requirements-red-team`, `sprint-planner`,
  `qa-reviewer`, `security-officer`, `devops-engineer`, `ai-auditor`,
  `ai-governance-reviewer`, `release-manager`.
- **F-202 — Sonnet agents.** Set `model: Claude Sonnet 4` for the 7 agents the
  policy assigns to Sonnet: `requirements-validator`, `sprint-validator`,
  `sprint-deduper`, `task-tester`, `implementation-validator`, `pr-opener`,
  `pr-merger`.
- **F-203 — Dynamic preserved.** `task-implementer` keeps `model: dynamic`
  (estimate/risk escalation), unchanged.

## Design constraints honored

- HARD RULE 19 — model intent stays single-sourced in `model-policy.md`; the
  `.agent.md` fields reference that policy and now use valid ids consistent
  with it.
- HARD RULE 20 — no `tools` lists were changed; least privilege preserved.
- HARD RULE 21 — frontmatter remains valid YAML (CI `ai-audit.yml`).

## Certification

This change touches `ai-auditor.agent.md` and `ai-governance-reviewer.agent.md`,
so it requires `ai-governance-reviewer` certification before merge (HARD RULE
25), with human approval for the `ai-governance-reviewer.agent.md` edit. The
edits are mechanical `model:` value substitutions only.
